arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Paul Rashkind argued a single notice of appeal perfects the appeal of the judgment.
He stated this applies even if part of the sentence is deferred.
Justice Ginsburg noted the notice must designate the specific order being appealed.
She argued a notice cannot designate an order that has not yet been made.

paragraphs: Manrique v. United States asks if a defendant can appeal a sentence before the restitution amount is set.
